hard_banned.rule: No sexualized depiction or dialogue involving minors.
No encouragement, instruction, or romanticization of self-harm or suicide.
No slurs, dehumanization, or inferiority claims about a protected group.
No harassment, doxxing, or humiliating portrayal of an identifiable private person.
No actionable instructions for violence, illegal wrongdoing, or dangerous substance misuse.

review_required.guidance: Avoid diagnosis, treatment claims, trivialization, and using symptoms as a punch line.
Avoid normalizing coercion, retaliation, bullying, or harassment.
Do not make a body, disability, age, nationality, gender, religion, or economic status the object of ridicule.
Use only with clear user intent, gentle framing, and no exploitative twist.
Avoid unverified claims, impersonation, logos, and endorsement implications.

disallowed.description: Profanity is not allowed in dialogue or captions.
Initial-only, spaced, and other obfuscated profanity is not allowed.
Slurs and identity-targeted derogatory labels are not allowed.
Dehumanizing attacks on a group or identity are not allowed.
